function: Designs the analog precoders and combiner of a massive MIMO in-band full-duplex link, maximizing achievable rate under self-interference, with deep-unfolded PGA and ZF-POCS iterations (p. 2-5).
system: Massive MIMO in-band full-duplex, two transceivers, 32 antennas each (nF=nL=nR=32), single RF chain, analog precoders; no RIS; band not stated (p. 2, 6).
method: Deep unfolding of projected gradient ascent (PGA) and ZF-POCS; learnable step sizes per layer, trained unsupervised with loss equal to negative achievable rate summed over layers (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh channels for all links; 300 training samples over 10 epochs, results averaged over 100 separate test samples; no dataset or measurements (p. 6).
test_conditions: Rayleigh channels throughout, default 32 antennas and 20 dB SNR; sweeps over loopback gain, SNR, antennas, and CSI error; training conditions per sweep not stated (p. 6-8).
baselines: Conventional (non-learned) PGA and ZF-POCS with fixed or decreasing hand-set step sizes; no earlier learned method; proposed unfolded variants compared with them (p. 6).
metrics: Channel achievable rate (bps/Hz); objective value per iteration (convergence); complexity as operations and iterations (p. 6-8).
complexity: Order O(L nR(9nF+13nL)) for unfolded PGA with L layers; O(L' nR(5nL+nR)) for unfolded ZF-POCS; Fig. 10 plots operations versus antennas (p. 5-6, 8).
q1_support: p. 6: "the Rayleigh model for all the channels" - custom Rayleigh simulator; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 6: "separated from the training ones" - held-out part of the same data; the sweeps over gain, SNR, antennas, and CSI error never state that a model trained elsewhere is tested.
q3_support: p. 6: "conventional ZF-POCS and PGA schemes" are the only baselines and are non-learned; no earlier learned method or standard network is compared.
q4_support: p. 5: "its complexity can be expressed as O(L(nR (9nF + 13nL ))),"
q5_support: p. 6: "the Rayleigh model for all the channels" - simulated data; no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset anywhere in the paper.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Included: deep unfolding with trained step sizes counts as learned; analog precoder and combiner design is area 3, with no sensing and no RIS. The antenna sweep (Fig. 7, p. 7) does not say the model was trained at another antenna count, so q2 is 0. Only conventional baselines, so q3 is 0.
